question: Who among the following was the President of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) as of December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sourav Ganguly.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sourav Chandidas Ganguly, affectionately known as Dada, is the 39th and the current president of the Board of Control for Cricket in India, an Indian cricket administrator, commentator, and former national cricket team captain.**
 
• On October 23, 2019, Ganguly became the 39th BCCI president, thus ending the** 33-month reign of the Supreme Court-appointed Committee of ****Administrators (CoA)** to run the cricket board's daily affairs.
 
• Sourav Ganguly is only the second cricketer from India to become the president of the BCCI.
 
• Ganguly, who played **113 tests and 311 one-day internationals and led ****India to 21 test wins**, has already been an administrator for the Cricket Association of Bengal, his home state association (CAB).
 
• In the past, he was part of the BCCI's technical panel and also, alongside** ****Sachin Tendulkar and VVS Laxman, part of a three-member Cricket Advisory Committee.​**
